subject: Testcases & Promptpack: data lease, escrow and destruction timetable
messages:
From: Claire Summers <claire@acmeretail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Testcases & Promptpack — lease, escrow and takedown questions

Hi Markus,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — Tom and I walked through the acceptance plan and we'd like to move forward with a short-term data lease for a set of prompt packs and the 1k testcases we discussed. Before we proceed we need a concrete mutual action plan (MAP) that covers:

- Exact access window for assets (start/end)
- Escrow / custody steps (who holds what and how transfers are logged)
- Usage constraints (no external redistribution, no productization, allowed testing only)
- Auditability (S3 access logs, query audit trail, timestamped manifests)
- Destruction / takedown procedure and verification

We have standard procurement language that requires an escrow expiration and destruction attestation within 7 days of lease end. Can Redwood provide a template MAP that includes those items plus a proposed timeline for close and delivery?

Attachments: none from our side yet — happy to share a sample CLA if needed.

Next step for us: once we have the MAP we can confirm legal signoff and send a DocuSign for the MPA. Can you target a timeline by EOW (May 28)?

Best,
Claire Summers
Head of ML Partnerships
Acme Retail
claire@acmeretail.com


From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Claire Summers <claire@acmeretail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcases & Promptpack — lease, escrow and takedown questions

Claire — thanks for the clear list. I've sketched a short MAP and attached two artifacts: MAP_draft_v1.pdf (the action plan and acceptance gates) and escrow_instructions.md (operational steps we propose for asset custody). High-level proposal below; the draft has the timeline and responsibilities table.

Proposed MAP highlights (short):
- Delivery: Redwood to provision ephemeral sandbox containing prompt packs + 1k testcases (read-only S3 bucket + ephemeral API keys) within 3 business days after DocuSign execution.
- Access window: 30-day lease by default; option to extend by one 14-day grace period with written request.
- Escrow: We will place a checksum manifest and encrypted archive in a mutually accessible escrow (third-party escrow provider suggested) at sign-off. Redwood retains a copy in an auditable, read-only vault. Escrow instructions document attached.
- Usage constraints: Testing-only; no redistribution, no model training outside of the agreed sandbox, no attempt at re-identification. We will watermark / tag testcases and lab outputs.
- Audit & logging: Access logs (S3 access logs + request IDs) will be delivered with the final report.
- Destruction: At lease expiry (or earlier termination), Redwood will destroy sandbox copies and provide a signed attestation and log extracts within 7 days. Escrow archive will be scheduled for deletion after the final attestation unless parties agree otherwise.
- Acceptance: QA pass/fail on a 100-case random sample (criteria in the draft MAP). If acceptance fails, a 7-day remediation window is provided.

Next steps:
1) Kimberly / Laura to review and send redlines (security and legal).
2) I'll update the MAP and send a DocuSign package for the MPA + data lease.
3) Upon execution, we provision access and start sprint testing.

Target: DocuSign out by Tue, May 25; execution and provisioning by Fri, May 28. If that timeline is tight for Acme, flag which dates you need shifted.

Attachments: MAP_draft_v1.pdf, escrow_instructions.md

Regards,
Markus Klein
Head of Partner Solutions, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0189

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: Claire Summers <claire@acmeretail.com>, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcases & Promptpack — lease, escrow and takedown questions

On Sat, May 22, 2027 at 11:05 AM Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Markus — thanks for the draft.

Claire / team — I pulled a quick set of redlines focused on usage controls and technical enforcement. Summary of our changes (attached as usage_restrictions_redlines.docx):

- Ephemeral tokens: keys will expire automatically after the lease window. No long-lived credentials are provided.
- Environment restrictions: sandbox will be isolated VPC with outbound egress limited (no external model calls) and writeops to the S3 bucket disabled; test outputs written only to a locked results store we manage.
- Watermarking: we will add lightweight metadata watermarks to each testcase and embed request IDs in output headers so we can detect exfiltration attempts.
- Monitoring & alerts: any bulk download attempts or unusual query patterns will trigger an automated alert to both security contacts and a temporary suspension of access pending review.
- Escrow key handling: escrow provider will store an encrypted archive; Redwood will only provide decryption keys on mutually agreed conditions.

I also tightened the takedown attestation language: attestation will include a manifest of deleted object keys, deletion timestamps, and sample log extracts. We should not set a blanket automatic deletion of escrow artifacts without a joint agreement.

Markus — if you want, I can merge these changes into MAP_draft_v1 and produce a v1.1 for DocuSign.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security PM, Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Claire Summers <claire@acmeretail.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 29 May 2027 15:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Testcases & Promptpack — lease, escrow and takedown questions

Markus / Kimberly / Laura — thanks for the fast iteration and the detailed redlines. Acme legal is comfortable with the changes Kimberly suggested aside from one ask: we need the default lease to be 45 days (rather than 30) with a single 14-day extension option. That gives our data science team enough runway for two rounds of validation.

If Redwood can accommodate 45 days by default, we agree to the MAP flow and will sign via DocuSign once you send the package. Our procurement team pulled the HubSpot deal record — Deal ID ACME-2027-119 — and asked that the DocuSign reference that ID.

Once signed: we expect provisioning within 3 business days and an initial kick-off sync (30 min) to walk the acceptance checklist. Please include your security contact in the DocuSign reminder.

Thanks — Claire
Claire Summers
Head of ML Partnerships
Acme Retail
claire@acmeretail.com
+1 (206) 555-0123
